caption.purpose: Timeline labels, graph footer, and supporting notes.

node-name.purpose: Single-line name beside the category icon in compact graph nodes.

code.purpose: Inspector XML values; paths elsewhere inherit their local size.

shadows.name: running-node-ring
shadows.purpose: Recorded RUNNING state; panels have no ambient shadow.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables animations and transitions; scroll behavior becomes auto.

components.name: Primary playback button
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-button-primary"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="m8 5 11 7-11 7Z"/></svg>Play</button>
components.css: .ds-button-primary {display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem; min-height: 40px; padding: .5rem .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d7e0ea); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #182b45); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease;} .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) {border-color: #91a4bd; background: var(--surface-soft, #f4f7fb);} .ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) {background: #e5ebf3;} .ds-button-primary {color: #fff; background: var(--accent, #245dcc); border-color: var(--accent, #245dcc);} .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled), .ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) {color: #fff; background: var(--accent-hover, #184ba9); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #184ba9);} .ds-button-primary:focus-visible {outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #245dcc); outline-offset: 3px;} .ds-button-primary:disabled {color: #69798c; background: #edf1f6; border-color: #e0e6ee; cursor: not-allowed;} @media (max-width: 600px) {.ds-button-primary {min-height: 44px;}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {.ds-button-primary {transition: none;}}

components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-button-quiet"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M3 10a9 9 0 1 1 2 8M3 4v6h6"/></svg>Reset</button>

components.name: Playback speed select
components.description: Native labeled select; the same control style is used for subtree visibility.
components.css: .ds-speed {display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; color: var(--muted, #53647a); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: .875rem;} .ds-select {min-height: 40px; min-width: 4.5rem; padding: .4rem .5rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d7e0ea); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #182b45); font: inherit; cursor: pointer;} .ds-select:hover:not(:disabled) {border-color: #91a4bd;} .ds-select:focus-visible {outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #245dcc); outline-offset: 3px;} .ds-select:disabled {cursor: not-allowed;} @media (max-width: 600px) {.ds-select {min-height: 44px;}} @media (max-width: 380px) {.ds-speed {flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: .125rem;}}

components.name: Tree breadcrumbs
components.description: Exact tree identifiers with a marked current page and horizontally scrollable overflow.
components.css: .ds-breadcrumbs {display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .25rem; list-style: none; padding: .25rem; margin: 0; min-width: 0; overflow-x: auto; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;} .ds-breadcrumbs li {display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .25rem; flex-shrink: 0;} .ds-breadcrumbs svg {width: 14px; color: var(--muted, #53647a);} .ds-breadcrumbs button {max-width: 25ch; min-height: 40px; padding: .375rem; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--muted, #53647a); background: transparent; font-family: inherit; font-size: .875rem; line-height: 1.5; cursor: pointer;} .ds-breadcrumbs button:hover {color: var(--accent, #245dcc); background: var(--accent-soft, #eaf1ff);} .ds-breadcrumbs button:focus-visible {outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #245dcc); outline-offset: 3px;} .ds-breadcrumbs [aria-current="page"] {font-weight: 650; color: var(--ink, #182b45);}

components.name: Behavior tree node
components.description: Compact Control node with split-arrow category icon and a thin neutral border matching connectors, recorded status fill, and selection outline. Hover and inspection expose metadata. Width follows the name, bounded to 160–360px; the graph uses the measured width for layout. Controls with children and SubTrees have a plus/minus toggle; double-click and Enter toggle the same branch. Successful Controls collapse by default unless on a RUNNING path; manual choices take priority.
components.html: top_level
components.css: .ds-node {box-sizing: border-box; width: fit-content; min-width: 160px; max-width: 360px; height: 76px; padding: 15px 17px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid #a4b2c5; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #182b45; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;} .ds-category-icon {flex-shrink: 0; color: #1d4ed8;} .ds-node-name {flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 30px;} .ds-node:hover {outline: 1px solid #91a4bd; outline-offset: 2px;} .ds-node.ds-running {background: #fffbeb; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #a16207;} .ds-node.ds-selected {outline: 2px solid #172033; outline-offset: 3px;} .ds-node:focus-visible {outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #182b45); outline-offset: 4px;} .ds-node-toggle {display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer;} .ds-node-toggle:hover:not(:disabled) {background: #eaf1ff; border-color: #245dcc;} .ds-node-toggle:focus-visible {outline: 3px solid #245dcc; outline-offset: 3px;} .ds-node-toggle:disabled {opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed;}

narrative.overview:
A precise engineering workspace with a midnight navy shell, an ice-blue canvas, white working surfaces, and cobalt controls. Compact controls support close inspection; the graph carries the visual weight.

Borders, aligned labels, and restrained spacing organize the interface. Category, recorded execution, and selection remain independently readable. Authored SVG icons accompany labels; this redesign adds no raster assets or external fonts.
keyCharacteristics: Separate category, status, and selection cues.
Flat surfaces and short control feedback.

rules.name: The Independent Signals Rule
rules.body: Keep category on its icon, execution in the node fill, and selection on an outer outline. Exact status text remains available on hover and in the inspector. A highlighted ancestor path does not change an ancestor's recorded status.

rules.name: The Readable Node Rule
rules.body: Preserve the 24px node name and 28px category icon at graph scale; keep secondary metadata in the inspector. Use Fit tree for the overview and Readable view for inspection.

dos: Do preserve the 160–360px width limits and 76px node height, thin neutral borders, and large node typography.
Do keep playback above the visualization, the legend below it, and definitions collapsed initially.
Do label every category icon and status fill in the legend; retain exact status text in hover descriptions and the inspector, keyboard focus, and accessible names for icon-only controls.
Do preserve exact XML identity, instance paths, and playback position through navigation.
donts: Don't use category color to imply execution status or selection.
Don't treat “Not observed” as IDLE or fabricate status for an ancestor on a running path.
Don't add decorative panels, raster imagery, or motion that competes with the graph.
Don't shrink graph labels to compensate for the whole-tree overview; retain the Readable view action.
